---
type: character
name: Ada Quill
want: To prove she belongs on the island and is not only a temporary hand
need: To accept that silence is not the same as disapproval
flaw: Fills every pause with talk, so she misses what people are not saying
voice: Talkative. Long sentences, many questions, and she names people when she speaks to them.
relationships:
  - character: veteran-keeper
    note: Ada wants Tomas to like her and reads his silences as a verdict. She is wrong more often than she expects.
---

Ada Quill arrives on the spring boat with two bags and a box of books she has not finished. She has never kept a light before, and she has read everything about it.
